slug: 2026-06-09 Beyond the Homepage Measuring What It Really Takes to Keep Web Traffic Local
note: Measures share of web content served locally (Malawi 3% local, 62% regional); states no rule on keeping data in the country.
A private data centre launch with an e-Government official saying data can be stored locally; no rule requiring data to stay in the country.
Passages name Malawi only as having a central-bank-led eKYC platform; no localisation rule stated.

facts.fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa's digital trade regulatory profile of Malawi states that Malawi has local storage requirements only for health-related data, naming no instrument; the document gives no date of its own, so the 2022 publication date is used (its data covers 2014-2021).
facts.system: Local storage requirement for health-related data

note: Guide headlines a localization barrier but describes only a condition on transfers abroad, which is not a rule to keep data at home.
